Author: Valentina Vieri
Name: VieriNexus
Punchline: Safe migration foundation for the unified Vieri experience.
Description: An early testing build of the unified, modular Vieri suite. It provides the Nexus shell, dependency validation, migration discovery, shared state, a verified read-only staged route library, fail-closed activation reporting, and a verified navigation Stop foundation without replacing or disabling the existing Vieri plugins.
